primary_method.name: DCF
primary_method.reasoning: AXT is loss-making on negative EBITDA, so a trailing multiple has no anchor. A long-horizon FCFF DCF that models the InP ramp and the path to cash generation is the honest way to value it; an EV/Sales cross-check anchors the rich near-term sales multiple. The central finding is how far intrinsic value sits below a 62x-trailing-sales price.

wacc.reasoning: Ke = 4.4% Rf + 1.40 beta x 5.5% ERP = 12.1%. Raw yfinance beta is 1.81; sanitized to 1.40 to blend the high single-stock volatility with the semi sector. A China-domicile and export-control risk premium plus small-cap illiquidity push toward the top of the 9-12% photonics/semi band. Net cash means debt weight ~0, so WACC sits at Ke ~12.0%.
wacc.adjudication_notes: 12.0% is the top of the photonics/semi band; justified by China manufacturing exposure, cyclicality, and small-cap float.

terminal_growth.reasoning: InP optical content should outgrow GDP for years as datacenter bandwidth scales, but a commodity-tilted substrate line with three credible suppliers does not earn a rich terminal; 3.5% is GDP-plus and defensible for the franchise at scale.

fcf_projections.rationale: FY26E +40% off the ~$96M TTM base on the InP datacenter ramp; FCF near zero as capex and a $80M+ inventory build absorb cash even as operating losses fade.
FY27E +35%: first year of positive operating margin as revenue laps the fixed cost base; FCF turns slightly positive.
FY28E +28%: operating leverage builds, ~7% FCF margin as utilization climbs and mix tilts to InP.
FY29E +22%: ~10% FCF margin; the 2022 peak earnings power (mid-20s EBITDA margin) becomes the reference, not the ceiling.
FY30E +18%: ~13% FCF margin as capex intensity eases off the ramp.
FY31E +14%: ~15% FCF margin; franchise scaling, growth decelerating off a larger base.
FY33E +9%: ~17% FCF margin, approaching steady state.
FY35E +5%: terminal-approach year, ~18% FCF margin mature franchise.

cross_check.name: Multiple
cross_check.reasoning: EV/Sales is the standard cross-check for loss-making hypergrowth. Peer set: optical and compound-semi names tied to AI interconnect. A generous 15x FY26E sales gives the bull theme its due and still lands far below the current $90.78, which is the central finding: the trailing 62x sales multiple has no fundamental support.

inputs.reasoning: 15x applied to FY26E revenue of ~$0.134B. Generous for an optical-substrate cohort that mostly trades single-digit to low-double-digit EV/sales; chosen to be fair to the theme. Even so it implies ~$31, roughly a third of spot.

scenarios.label: Bear
scenarios.probability_reasoning: Heavy weight. The cycle rolling (revenue already halved 2022-to-2023), an inventory writedown off the $81.7M build, China export-license friction, and multiple compression are concrete, dateable downside drivers, not tail risks.
scenarios.reasoning: AI-optical double-ordering digests in 2026-2027, revenue contracts, margins relapse, and a China export shock strands shipments; the multiple compresses with no fundamental floor.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.probability_reasoning: Central case. The InP ramp continues and AXT reaches sustained operating profit mid-horizon, but even this constructive path leaves the stock valued far ahead of intrinsic value.
scenarios.reasoning: Steady InP-led ramp with operating leverage delivering mid-to-high-teens FCF margin by the early 2030s, mirroring 2022 peak earnings power as a reference.

scenarios.label: Bull
scenarios.probability_reasoning: Lower odds. Requires InP optical demand to push revenue toward $1B with margins above the 2022 peak, co-packaged optics extending the roadmap, and China supply friction never biting.
scenarios.reasoning: AXT becomes the default InP substrate for the multi-generation optical roadmap; revenue and FCF margins beat the base path materially.

blending_logic: 40% Base DCF + 30% Bear DCF + 15% Bull DCF + 15% EV/Sales cross-check.
weights_reasoning: Base 40% reflects a constructive but realistic InP ramp. Bear gets a heavy 30% because the 2022-to-2023 revenue halving, the $81.7M inventory overhang, China export-control exposure, and 62x-sales multiple compression are concrete near-term catalysts, not tail events. Bull 15% for the demand-acceleration case. The EV/Sales cross-check carries 15% to anchor with a relative lens; even a generous 15x sales lands near $31, well below spot, which is the central finding of the work.
